popupUpload.context: Button in the compact popup. It opens editor.html; it does not upload a file.

dropSubtitle.context: Subtitle in empty editor drop zone, above the Choose an image button.

pickFromSiteSub.message: Select an image directly on the page
pickFromSiteSub.context: Subtitle of the website-image picker card.

badgeLocal.context: Trust badge meaning processing/storage happens on the user's device, not geographic local.

localNote.message: Processed on your device. Nothing is uploaded.

gotIt.context: Dismiss action in the prompt that asks user to pin Picture Converter to Chrome toolbar.

fbCardText.message: Conversions completed: $N$ — a quick rating helps others find Picture Converter.
fbCardText.context: Rating prompt after multiple completed conversions.

batchTitle.context: Title when multiple selected images will be combined into one PDF.

batchSkippedBad.context: Status appended after batch load when some selected files could not be read.

batchTooMany.context: Status appended when selected files exceed the PDF batch limit.

batchReady.message: Pages ready: $N$ — reorder if needed, then download.
batchReady.context: Batch status after pages are loaded.

downloadPdfPages.context: Download button for a multi-page PDF.

popupBlocked.message: Image selection isn't available on this page. Open a website and try again.
popupBlocked.context: Popup helper shown when current Chrome page cannot be scripted.

pickerSelectingHint.message: Click an image, or press Esc to cancel
pickerSelectingHint.context: Shown while image picker mode is active.

downloadFmt.context: Primary download button; placeholder is output format label.

qualityLabel.context: Label for JPG/WebP export quality control.

downloadAgainBtn.context: Post-download action to download same result again.

convertAnotherBtn.context: Post-download action to start another conversion.

menuQuick.context: Chrome image context-menu action using remembered output format.

menuTo.context: Chrome image context-menu action for a specific output format.

openFullEditor.context: Open the same editor as a full browser tab/page instead of side panel.

alphaWarnFlatten.message: ⚠ Transparency will be replaced with white.
alphaWarnFlatten.context: Warning when output format cannot preserve alpha/transparency.

decodingHeic.message: Decoding HEIC (loading decoder for the first time)…
decodingHeic.context: Status while HEIC decoder is loaded on first use.

openSiteFail.message: Couldn't open a website: $ERR$. Open a page with images, then press Alt+Shift+C.
openSiteFail.context: Error when site picker cannot open/start; includes technical error placeholder and recovery shortcut.

fromPageFail.context: Error when chosen page image cannot be transferred into editor.

inputFormats.message: Supports: PNG · JPG · WEBP · GIF · BMP · JFIF · SVG · AVIF · HEIC

tipShortcut.message: ⌨ Press Alt+Shift+C to select an image on any website

tipRightClick.message: ⚡ Faster: use the right-click menu to convert an image
tipRightClick.context: Tip explaining context-menu workflow without embedding a second localized command label.
